cd /workspace/project && echo "=== nomask: key LIVE / total ==="; grep -c "| LIVE" nomask_live_keys.txt; grep -c "| HABIS" nomask_live_keys.txt; echo; echo "=== total api_win sepanjang waktu ==="; grep -c '"api_win"' nm2_results.jsonl; echo "=== hasil batch terakhir (run ini) ==="; tail -1 nm_batch_run.log 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== ringkasan per status ==="; python3 -c "
import json,collections
c=collections.Counter()
